lead.en: Tune an editable draft with host-provided rewrites.
lead.zh: 通过宿主提供的改写结果调整可编辑草稿。

rule.en: The host runs rewrites and handles cancellation. The sample is simulated; Copy uses the real clipboard.
rule.zh: 宿主负责改写与取消。示例为模拟数据；复制使用真实剪贴板。

api.en: A settings change waits 220 ms, then emits Rewrite with a ticket. Stop or a new edit emits Cancel; finish and fail reject stale results or a changed draft. User edits become the source for future rewrites.
api.zh: 设置变化后等待 220ms，随后发出带 ticket 的 Rewrite。停止或继续编辑会发出 Cancel；finish 与 fail 忽略过期结果及已改变的草稿。用户编辑会成为后续改写的来源。

motion.en: Sliders use shared KUI motion and changed words can be highlighted. Sentence crossfades and full reference comparison remain unimplemented or unverified.
motion.zh: 滑块采用 KUI 共用动效，并可突出显示变化的词句。逐句淡入淡出及完整参考对照尚未实现或验收。
